trap.label: give (sentidos)
trap.wrong: This phone makes clear sound, makes me a headache and I put it 4 stars.
trap.right: This phone gives clear sound, gave me a headache, and I give it 4 stars.
trap.why: Em português “dá som claro”, “me deu dor de cabeça”, “dou 4 estrelas” e o brasileiro traduz como make/put. Em inglês, give.

mcq.q: I ___ a gift to my friend.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “It gives me a headache.”
Reescreva com give: “My rating is four stars.” (I...)
Reescreva com give: “She offered a gift to him.”
